info.name: Get a list of unconfirmed transactions currently in the transaction pool.

params.name: max
params.description: Truncated number of transactions to display. If max=0, returns all pending txns.

params.name: format
params.description: Configures whether the response object is JSON or MessagePack encoded. If not provided, defaults to JSON.

items.docs: Get the list of pending transactions, sorted by priority, in decreasing order, truncated at the end at MAX. If MAX = 0, returns all pending transactions.

params.name: format
params.description: Configures whether the response object is JSON or MessagePack encoded. If not provided, defaults to JSON.

items.docs:
Given a transaction ID of a recently submitted transaction, it returns information about it.  There are several cases when this might succeed:
- transaction committed (committed round > 0)
- transaction still in the pool (committed round = 0, pool error = "")
- transaction removed from pool due to error (committed round = 0, pool error != "")
Or the transaction may have happened sufficiently long ago that the node no longer remembers it, and this will return an error.
